name: Automatic Alt Text Generator for Images
author: webAufstieg GmbH

sections.description:
Automatically generate alt text for your WordPress – WooCommerce images using AI. Supports bulk updates, product-based content, and boosts SEO & accessibility.

We’ve developed a powerful WordPress – WooCommerce plugin that uses advanced AI image analysis to automatically generate accurate alt text, image titles, captions, and descriptions. Built for SEO professionals and accessibility-focused users, it delivers exceptional flexibility and efficiency.

Supports Multiple Image Formats: Compatible with JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP for seamless processing across all major image types.

Alt Text with SEO Keywords: Add focus Keyword from SEO plugins like Rank Math, Yoast SEO, All in One SEO, Squirrly SEO, SmartCrawl and SEOPress to ensure SEO optimized alt text.

Full History & Easy Editing – Access past image processing records and quickly review or edit alt texts whenever needed.

Custom GPT Prompts – Personalize how descriptions are written using your own prompts, ensuring the tone and focus align with your brand.

Highlights
– Automatic AI-Powered Alt Text
– Bulk Image Processing
– Process Individual Image
– Included / Excluded Keywords
– Product-Based Alt Text for WooCommerce
– Supports Accessibility Compliance (WCAG, ADA)
– Multilingual Capabilities
– Improves Image SEO Effortlessly

Key Features:
– Image Processing History
– Update from History
– AutoAlt.ai Writing Style
– Process Images with Specific File Extensions only
– Include images with existing alt text and overwrite them.
– Capture Error Details
– Secured API with Domain
– API Support (Staging & Live)
– Try for FREE

Installation steps

  1. Go to Plugins > Add Plugin in your WordPress dashboard.

  2. Search for “Auto Alt AI”.

  3. From the search results, find the Auto Alt AI plugin.

  4. Click on the Install Now button, then click on the Activate button.

  5. Visit https://autoalt.ai to sign up for a free trial or choose a paid plan.

  6. Copy your API key from your AutoAlt.ai account.

  7. Go to the plugin’s Settings page in WordPress and paste the API key to link your account.

  8. Upload an image – the plugin will automatically generate alt text for it.

Frequently Asked Questions

  1. How can I update alt text for multiple images?

Option 1: Bulk Update via AutoAlt.ai

  • In your WordPress admin panel, go to AutoAlt.ai → Bulk Generate.

  • You’ll see a list of images missing alt text.

  • Click to generate alt text for all of them in bulk.

Option 2: Update from the Media Library

  • Switch to list view in the Media Library.

  • Select the images you want to update.

  • Choose AutoAlt.ai: Generate Alt Text from the Bulk Actions dropdown, then click Apply.

  1. Can I update alt text for a single image?

Yes! Open the image in your WordPress Media Library. You’ll see a Generate ALT Text button.
Clicking it will generate and set alt text for that image only.

    Note: This will overwrite any existing alt text.
  1. Can I include SEO keywords in the alt text?

Yes. AutoAlt.ai integrates seamlessly with popular SEO plugins like:
– Yoast SEO

  • Rank Math

  • All in One SEO

  • Squirrly SEO

  • SEOPress

Just make sure your post has a focus keyword set. When you upload or update images within that post, AutoAlt.ai will intelligently incorporate the keywords into the alt text.

  1. Do I own the alt text that is generated?

Absolutely. You retain full ownership of any alt text generated through AutoAlt.ai.

We do not:
– Claim rights to your content

  • Use your alt text for AI training

  • Share it with third parties

Alt text is stored in your account for convenience only.

  1. Will I lose my alt text if I uninstall the plugin?

No. Any alt text you’ve generated using AutoAlt.ai will remain on your images—even after uninstalling the plugin.

  1. Does AutoAlt.ai support languages other than English?

Yes., AutoAlt.ai supports 100+ languages, making it ideal for multilingual websites.

  1. Do you store the images I upload?

No, We do not store your images or binary files.
AutoAlt.ai only accesses:
– Image URLs

  • Generated alt text

  • Any metadata you’ve provided

  1. How do credits and pricing plans work?

We offer both subscription plans and one-time credit pack.

  • Standard image formats (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP) use 1 credit per image.

  • 25 free credits are included for new accounts.

  • Unused credits roll over to the next billing cycle.

  • You can cancel at any time without losing your unused credits.

  1. What happens if I cancel my subscription?

When you cancel:
– Your subscription stops renewing automatically.

  • You won’t be charged further.

  • Any unused credits remain in your account.

  1. Can I use AutoAlt.ai on multiple websites?

Yes, You can add as many websites as you want to your AutoAlt.ai account. Just add each domain to your account. As long as you have credits available, you can generate alt text across all sites.

  1. What types of images are supported?

AutoAlt.ai supports all major formats:
– JPG / JPEG

  • PNG

  • GIF

  • WebP

Requirements:
– Image size under 16MB

  • Minimum dimensions of 50×50 pixels
  1. Does AutoAlt.ai support SEO plugins?

Yes, AutoAlt.ai integrates with the following SEO plugins for keyword-optimized alt text:

  • Rank Math

  • Yoast SEO

  • All in One SEO

  • Squirrly SEO

  • SmartCrawl

  • SEOPress

  1. Can I view my image processing history?

Yes, You can access your image processing history to:
– Review previously generated alt text

  • Re-edit or update alt text at any time
